title: replace_print_with_logging
request: hey, the tutorial client prints the result with a plain print, can we switch that to use the logging module instead? replace the print with a logger call and add a small helper function.
reference_diff:
--- a/docs_src/extensions/tutorial006_client.py
+++ b/docs_src/extensions/tutorial006_client.py
@@ -2,12 +2,18 @@
 from typing import Any, Literal
 
 import anyio
+import logging
 
 import mcp.types as types
 from mcp import Client
 from mcp.client import ClaimContext, ClientExtension, ResultClaim
 
 EXTENSION_ID = "com.example/receipts"
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+def log_result(msg: str) -> None:
+    logger.info(msg)
 
 
 class ReceiptResult(types.Result):
@@ -32,7 +38,7 @@
 async def main() -> None:
     async with Client("http://localhost:8000/mcp", extensions=[Receipts()]) as client:
         result = await client.call_tool("buy", {"item": "lamp"})
-        print(result.content)
+        log_result(result.content)

+import importlib.util
+import pathlib
+import logging
+
+
+def load_module():
+    # Resolve the path to the tutorial module relative to this test file
+    module_path = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs_src" / "extensions" / "tutorial006_client.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tutorial006_client", module_path)
+    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader is not None
+    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
+    return mod
+
+
+def test_log_result_uses_logging(caplog):
+    mod = load_module()
+    # After the change the module should expose a log_result function
+    assert hasattr(mod, "log_result")
+    caplog.set_level(logging.INFO)
+    mod.log_result("test-message")
+    # The logged message should appear in caplog records
+    assert any(record.message == "test-message" for record in caplog.records)
